q1_issues.issue: (During sk_close_1 sk_trade_1) renders the surface preposition 'in', but the head must be the preposition actually used — 'in' stays 'In', and 'During' renders only the word 'during'.

The measure scale 'increase' is invented — the text says 'up 64 cents' and states no dimension word — and it records a change as a Measure, so the same close event now carries two competing values (23.40 dollar, 64 cent) under two scales.
The closing price is measured of the closing event rather than of the stock; Measure is defined over an entity, and the instruction set attaches it to an event only for 'duration'.

q2_gaps: a bare differential with no stated standard ('up 64 cents') — MoreBy needs both compared relata and the previous close is never mentioned

a time-indexed / point-in-time value ('closed Wednesday at $23.40') — Measure has no slot for the time at which the value held, forcing the price onto either the entity (losing the time) or the event (mis-slotting the bearer)
an event-nominalization used as a circumstantial frame ('in trading on the Nasdaq market') — the nesting head During is licensed only for during/while/throughout
notes: The genitive 'Allegiant's stock' -> Possession, the Weekday time term, close -> Patient, and 'the Nasdaq market' as name-symbol + separate kind atom are all correct per the instruction set. The framing PP was also given its own (Past sk_trade_1), which the adjunct event-noun rule ('nothing else') would arguably withhold.
